newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Fila leaps on EPS report.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Fila leaps on EPS report.

text.p: Fila Holdings SpA's American Depositary Receipts rallied strongly preceding Thursday's U.S. market open on earnings-inspired buying.

Traders said Fila's NYSE-listed ADRs rose 5-3/8 to 81 after the Italian athletic apparel and footware company posted third quarter earnings of $1.61 per ADR, up from $0.91 a year ago. Each ADR represents five ordinary shares.
The Zacks' consensus estimate for the third quarter was $1.45 per share.
Revenues for the period climbed to $401.8 million from $269.3 million.

Meanwhile, Intel Corp shares were unchanged to slightly weaker ahead of the market open, capping a sharp move higher in the prior session driven by the company's expectation fourth quarter revenues and gross margin surpassing the third quarter's $5.14 billion and 57 percent, respectively.

Elsewhere, Donnkenny Inc shares were in a pre-open freefall -- off six points to 6-1/2 -- driven by the announcement last night that KPMG Peat Marwick resigned as the company's auditors, traders said.
Donnkenny also said it named Stewart Levy as chief financial officer and Deloitte and Touche LLP was named new auditor.
Donnkenny is a women's apparel company.
